title: The Dark Annals of Asshai
narration_slice: If you consult the dark annals of Asshai-by-the-Shadow on how humble shepherds became dragonriders, you will hear a tale that strips Valyria of its proudest boast. In those bleak, candle-lit libraries beside the black River Ash, ancient scrolls insist that the Valyrians did
location: LOC-ESS-003 Asshai-by-the-Shadow (archive interior, river wall, city vista)
creature_refs: none - the only appearance this batch is the rejected 0453, which will be replaced
asshai_lock: Greasy matte light-drinking black stone; perpetual twilight; dim BLOOD-RED shadowbinder lanterns only. The narration's word 'candle-lit' was translated into one or two guttering tallow flames rather than warm golden light - warm amber would have broken the location's palette the way gold broke Qarth's.
scroll_rule: Every scroll in this batch is ROLLED, CLOSED, BOUND, CAGED or turned end-out. Not one line of script, glyph, rune, numeral, map or diagram appears in any approved frame. This is the established precedent from 0374 and 0284: a beat about written records is solved by the absence of writing.
figure_rule: All Asshai'i are anonymous: deep hoods, backs, hands, shadow. No face is visible in any approved frame.

scenes.visual_beat: Low-angle monumental architectural / geological framing — Candlelit Asshai archives challenging Valyria's boast
scenes.qc_note: 28mm low-angle up the shelf-hall. The strongest frame of the batch: hundreds of ROLLED, CLOSED, CORD-BOUND scrolls stacked floor to ceiling in niches cut from light-drinking black stone, a single blood-red shadowbinder lantern in the left foreground and a guttering tallow at the floor, both giving more shadow than light. The scrolls read as abundance without legibility, which is the only honest way to photograph a library that must contain no writing. Full-bleed.

scenes.visual_beat: Over-the-shoulder depth perspective — Candlelit Asshai archives challenging Valyria's boast
scenes.qc_note: 40mm over the shoulder of an anonymous archivist: black hood soft in the left foreground, one pale hand on the table edge, and three closed hide scrolls bound in black cord with metal caps and plain wax lying on the red-lit black stone. Every scroll is shut and the cord is still knotted. The red lantern pool on the stone is the only colour. Full-bleed.

scenes.visual_beat: Deep-focus wide atmospheric composition — Candlelit Asshai archives challenging Valyria's boast
scenes.shot_type: 28mm deep-focus wide of the archive's central gallery
scenes.qc_note: REJECTED on architecture. The gallery reads as a Roman basilica, not Asshai: square piers with MOULDED CAPITALS and BASES, courses of dressed ashlar with regular joints, and a coffered floor of square pavers with visible grout lines. Asshai is cyclopean, sharp-angled and jointless, its stone light-drinking and unornamented - no capitals, no bases, no cornices, no dressed coursing. The hoods also sit as flat dark masks on upright bodies, reading as a modern reading room rather than a processional of shadowed figures.
scenes.rerender_brief: Rebuild the gallery as cyclopean: monolithic black piers cut from single blocks, each one sharp-angled, jointless, tapering irregularly, with no capital, no base, no moulding, no cornice and no regular coursing anywhere. The floor should be one continuous pour of the same black stone, worn slick, with no pavers and no grout lines. The figures must be deep-hooded, bent forward and heavy-shouldered, their hoods hanging lower than the crown of the head so no face or mask plane appears. Negate: ashlar, dressed stone, coursed masonry, square pavers, column capital, base moulding, cornice, entablature.

scenes.visual_beat: Ultra-wide establishing vista — Candlelit Asshai archives challenging Valyria's boast
scenes.qc_note: 24mm ultra-wide from a high ledge: Asshai-by-the-Shadow in receding layers of grey-green mist, sharp-angled black stone pyramids, stepped palaces and a monolithic bridge over the poison-black River Ash, a few dull red lantern points on the quays. No sun, no sky, no vegetation, no boats. The whole city reads as abandoned and is not. Reframed 11-767.

scenes.visual_beat: Medium close-up atmospheric focal beat — Candlelit Asshai archives challenging Valyria's boast
scenes.qc_note: 50mm at shelf height: two pale, long-fingered hands resting on the top cylinder of three closed scrolls, fine dust in the grain of the cracked hide, a coil of black cord and a small iron key beside them, one blood-red lantern out of focus above. Cropped above the chest so no face and no head appear. Nothing is open. Full-bleed.

scenes.visual_beat: Dynamic medium lateral tracking angle — Candlelit Asshai archives challenging Valyria's boast
scenes.qc_note: 35mm lateral tracking: a single hooded figure crosses the aisle from left to right, head fully inside a deep conical hood so no face exists from any angle, one pale hand clamped on four closed scrolls held against the chest, the near shelves streaked with motion blur and the red lanterns smeared into short streaks. Movement and urgency in a building with no daylight. Full-bleed.

scenes.visual_beat: Compressed telephoto dramatic subject framing — Candlelit Asshai archives challenging Valyria's boast
scenes.qc_note: 65mm macro compression: one cracked closed scroll at an angle, black cord binding and a dull metal seal ring, its far end off frame so no surface can be read, beside a stub of tallow in a rusted cup smoking more than it burns. Behind, hundreds of identical closed cylinders smeared into a red murk. The tightest, most claustrophobic frame of the batch. Reframed 12-755.

scenes.visual_beat: Medium cinematic subject focus — Candlelit Asshai archives challenging Valyria's boast
scenes.qc_note: 50mm: an archivist at a metre-thick slit window, one hand flat on the ledged sill, three closed scrolls under the other arm, looking out at the black River Ash and the silhouette of a bridge in grey-green mist. The slot is too narrow to reveal a face from behind. A blood-red lantern above the sill is the only warm note. Reframed 12-754.

scenes.visual_beat: Wide environmental storytelling tableau — Candlelit Asshai archives challenging Valyria's boast
scenes.qc_note: 35mm wide from floor level: the great shelf-hall as a cavern, massive sharp-angled black piers and a low heavy ceiling, thousands of closed scrolls on every side and bundles stacked on the floor tied with cord, four dim red lanterns hung high, dust in the air catching the red. One tiny hooded archivist at the foot of a shelf, the only vertical in the frame. Reframed 12-767.
